description: Execute the upstream Origami relational-core R0 contract using simultaneous deterministic rounds and finite outcomes.

invariants.description: The output contract must be origami.relational-core.r0.
Relations and semantic values must produce the upstream terminal state.
All effects use prior-round state and commit simultaneously.
Ordered applied IDs and causal evidence must match the upstream fixture.
Only declared finite terminal outcomes are valid.
Execution must stop at the declared finite budget.
Return exactly one strict machine-readable result.

output.schema: Return exactly one JSON object with contract, outcome, state, trace, steps, evidence, and errors. trace contains ordered {step,applied} entries. Do not emit extra fields or prose.

identity: Execute origami.relational-core.r0 exactly from the declared entities, relations, rules, simultaneous-round policy, and finite budget.

rules.description: Every effect in a round is calculated from the prior-round state and committed simultaneously.
Classify as FIXED_POINT, CYCLE, CONTRADICTION, or BUDGET_EXHAUSTED only.
